name: explorer-for-twincat
description: XAE-like TwinCAT PLC project tree, an XAE-like declaration/implementation split editor and Structured Text language features

virtualWorkspaces.description: In the browser (vscode.dev, github.dev) the TwinCAT tree, the editors, the Structured Text features, the comparisons with HEAD, and the TwinCAT Changes, Commits and History views and blame (from GitHub) work; staging and the MCP server need VS Code on the desktop.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Search the Structured Text of the TwinCAT objects as the split editor shows it, unsaved edits included.
[Search...](command:twincatExplorer.search)
Right-click a PLC project or a folder in the TwinCAT tree to search only there (Find in Folder...).

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Explorer for TwinCAT
walkthroughs.description: Where the TwinCAT tree, Go to Object, Search and the per-object git views are.

steps.title: Open the Solution tree
steps.description:
The TwinCAT icon in the Activity Bar holds the projects as XAE shows them, and the History of the open object.
[Open the TwinCAT View](command:workbench.view.extension.twincat)

steps.title: Go to any object
steps.description:
Ctrl+Alt+T lists every POU, method, property, DUT and GVL.
[Go to Object...](command:twincatExplorer.goToObject)

steps.title: Search the Structured Text
steps.description:
Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F searches the code of the objects, never their XML; the results are in the Panel.
[Search...](command:twincatExplorer.search)

steps.title: Review and commit per object
steps.description:
TwinCAT Changes in Source Control lists the changed objects; stage, discard and commit them one by one.
[Show TwinCAT Changes](command:twincatExplorer.changes.focus)

twincatExplorer.autoReveal.description: Select the active TwinCAT object or file in the TwinCAT tree.

twincatExplorer.foldersFirst.description: Sort folders before objects in the TwinCAT tree.

enumDescriptions: XAE-like editor: Declaration above Implementation, each with its own scroll bar, resizable.
Notebook with one cell per section.
twincatExplorer.editor.description: Editor that TwinCAT objects open in from the TwinCAT tree, Go to Object and go to definition. Either can also be chosen per tab with Reopen Editor With.

twincatExplorer.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report Structured Text problems (syntax, unknown identifiers, unknown members) in open TwinCAT editors and notebooks.

twincatExplorer.diagnostics.ignore.description: Identifiers that are never reported as unknown (for example symbols of a library without a stub).

twincatExplorer.stubFiles.description: Extra Structured Text stub files with library declarations (absolute paths or paths relative to the first workspace folder). Wrap declarations in LIBRARY <Name> ... END_LIBRARY.

twincatExplorer.libraryRepositories.description: Folders of TwinCAT library repositories (absolute paths) that Add Library... lists the libraries of, and that the language features read the names of referenced libraries from (their browsercache), besides the system repository of TwinCAT 3.1.4026 (%ProgramData%\Beckhoff\TwinCAT\PlcEngineering\Managed Libraries) and of 3.1.4024 and older (%TWINCAT3DIR%Components\Plc\Managed Libraries). For the repositories added in XAE's Library Repository dialog: the folder that holds <Company>\<Library>\<Version> folders, or one with such a folder in it (a clone of the SPT Libraries). Full declarations come from stubs (twincatExplorer.stubFiles).

twincatExplorer.exclude.description: Glob of folders ignored when searching for .tsproj files. Folders whose name starts with a dot (for example .claude/worktrees) are always ignored.

twincatExplorer.saveThroughXae.markdownDescription: When TwinCAT XAE has the project open, save edits of TwinCAT objects through XAE: XAE shows the change at once and saves the object itself, instead of asking to reload the file. Unsaved edits of the same object in XAE are asked about first. Each save then looks for the running XAE instances first. Windows only; with XAE closed the file is written. Off: saves write the file, and never ask XAE anything.

twincatExplorer.licenseStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show in the status bar how long the TwinCAT license that ends first, of this machine or of a remote system (`twincatExplorer.remoteLicenses`), has left (usually the 7-day trial license), warned about a day before it ends and once it has expired. Click it for each license of each runtime (`TwinCAT: Show Licenses`). Windows only, in a workspace with TwinCAT projects.

twincatExplorer.remoteLicenses.markdownDescription: Also read the licenses of the remote TwinCAT systems this machine's AMS router has routes to (an XAR in a container or a virtual machine, a PLC), over ADS every 5 minutes, for the status bar and `TwinCAT: Show Licenses`. Only reads their license files. Needs TwinCAT XAE installed here.

twincatExplorer.blame.currentLine.description: Show at the end of the current line of the split editor who last changed it, when, and the commit message (like GitLens' current line blame). Open Changes in its hover shows the commit's changes of the object.

scripts.compile: tsc -p . && node scripts/build-vendor.js && tsc -p src/webview && node scripts/build-webview.js && node scripts/build-mcp.js && node scripts/build-web.js
scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:unit
